summary: Validated 2 new SPILIVERE features: (1) Manual payment with per-country gating + auto-record activation flow and (2) Spillover commission new rules (direct 100% profit / beneficiary 50/50 capped at next level price). Backend: 12/12 NEW tests PASS (8 manual-payment + 4 commission scenarios) plus 36/36 regression team-endpoint tests PASS. Frontend: admin /Réglages shows 12-country checkbox grid with TG/BJ/BF pre-checked (DB state). User /activation (TG user) correctly displays manual-payment section with country picker limited to {TG, BJ, BF}, operator picker, phone input and PAYER 2 500 FCFA button.

minor.issue: When manual payment is disabled OR country not allowed, returns 400 with generic message. Functional but consider distinct error codes (e.g. 'disabled' vs 'country_not_allowed') for clearer UX-side handling.

issues: Country picker uses raw 2-letter codes (TG/BJ/BF) — consider showing the flag emoji + full name to match the admin Réglages page which already does this nicely (e.g. 'TG Togo').

action_items: (Optional) On /activation manual payment card, show country names + flags instead of raw 2-letter codes (improves consistency with admin Réglages).
(Optional) Split 'manual not available' 400 errors into distinct error codes so frontend can show user-specific message (disabled vs country_not_allowed).

Note: /app/backend/tests/test_spilivere_api.py uses obsolete admin creds (admin@spiloveure.com); 5 tests error at setup. Unrelated to this iteration. Can be updated to read ADMIN_EMAIL/ADMIN_PASSWORD from env.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/activations/manual-request correctly enforces enabled + country whitelist + max_level<1 + idempotency on duplicate pending. Activation document includes payer_country, operator, payment_phone, amount=2500 — admin sees all needed fields.
server.py PUT /api/admin/settings/manual-payment correctly normalizes country codes to uppercase + strip + filters empties. Confirmed by automated test.

matrix.py distribute_commission new spillover rules: direct sponsor → 100% profit (no upgrade reserve); spillover beneficiary → 50/50 capped at next-level price (100% profit when reserve full or user at max_level=12). All 4 scenarios pass.

Frontend /activation correctly filters allowed_countries from /api/settings/manual-payment public endpoint and hides the section when user country not in allowlist (by exclusion of country in picker).

success_rate.backend: 100% on this iteration (12/12 new + 36/36 regression team-endpoints); 5 unrelated legacy spilivere_api tests skipped due to obsolete creds
success_rate.frontend: 100% — admin Réglages country grid renders + saves, user /activation manual section displays correctly with country gating
